name: Release game listeners and animation frames on stop
instruction: A CarnivalGame start method returns a cleanup function that cancels its active animation frame and removes every event listener it added.
relevant_when: The file contains a start(canvas) method and calls requestAnimationFrame or addEventListener inside it.
context: AGENTS.md house rule 5 and the CarnivalGame contract in src/carnival/registry.ts require a game to release resources when the player leaves its booth.
scope_reason: The start method contains both resource registration and its returned teardown function.

checklist.name: matched-cleanup
checklist.rule: The returned function removes each listener added by start and cancels the active scheduled animation frame, including the frame most recently requested by a running loop.
